    First Block with Daniela Amodei, President and Co-founder at Anthropic

    By Anastasia Crew

    Startup Marketing Lead

    1 min read
    Share this post

    Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

    Please watch it on YouTube

    Listen to the First Block podcast on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and your other favorite podcast platforms.

    Download Anthropic's project planner template. To learn more about how Notion is supporting startups, please visit notion.com/startups.

    Welcome to First Block, a Notion series where founders and executives from the world's leading companies tell us about the many “firsts” of their startup journeys. Hosted by our Co-founder and COO Akshay Kothari, this series explores the many ups and downs that founders face as they build their companies, and what they've learned along the way.

    Daniela Amodei is the Co-Founder & President at Anthropic. Anthropic is an AI research company that builds reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. Their first product is Claude, an AI assistant that can handle tasks at any scale.

    In this episode, we do a deep-dive into:

    • The importance of a strong founding team

    • The evolution of responsibilities at a fast-growing company

    • Balancing Honesty, Helpfulness, and Harmlessness in AI Development

    • How AI is rapidly changing and its future

    • Why user feedback is important for product development
